card.title: No. 3 COMMANDO
card.text: Units with 4 or more attack cannot attack.
card.flavorText: No. 3 Commando was a battalion sized unit of the 1st Special Service Brigade that was formed in 1940 and was the first unit to carry the “Commando” title. Their first operation was a failed raid on the German occupied Channel island of Guernsey, but in 1941 Nr. 3 took part in successful raids on Lofoten Islands and Vaagso in Norway. In 1942 Nr. 3 was involved in the Allied Dieppe raid, which was a failed amphibious assault on the port of Dieppe in Northern France. The year after the unit was shipped to North Africa from where they participated in the Allied invasion of Sicily, but afterwards they were sent back to Britain to prepare for Operation Overlord. On D-Day in 1944 Nr. 3 Commando landed on Sword Beach where they were tasked with linking up with the 6th Airborne Division. By then the unit was no longer used for small scale raiding missions and was mostly deployed as an elite infantry assault unit, and as such they would fight with the Allied forces on the Western Front until the war in Europe ended. After the German surrendered Nr. 3 was tasked with occupational duties before being sent home to Britain in 1946 and disbanded.
